definitions.explanation: Shoveling the snow that has piled up on a roof down to the ground, so that its weight does not damage the house. A regular and dangerous winter chore in heavy-snow regions.

examples.english: To clear the snow off the roof.

examples.japanese: {雪|ゆき}{下|お}ろし⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧な⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Clearing snow from roofs is dangerous work.
